sources.notes: Classes and membership. Found by discovery v3 on 2026-10-06; not yet reviewed.

access.quote: Raku is a low-temperature fast-firing technique that achieves unique metallic and lustrous surfaces by cooling the piece in a smoky atmosphere. We will cover basic and specialty raku techniques including Halo, Slip Resist (or Naked Raku), Copper Mat, Obvara, Horsehair. Smoke Firing techniques will include Saggar and Terra Sigillata. Students will see examples and demonstrations and be able to try the techniques.

verify.why: The text describes a Raku class open to outsiders (limited to 8 students, registration available) and mentions Saggar firing techniques within the raku instruction.
